description: This Java class defines the data structure for an interoperation quote request within the Fineract platform, including fields for quote code, amount type, fees, and validation/parsing logic.

classes.name: InteropQuoteRequestData
classes.description: Represents a quote request data structure for interoperation, including validation and normalization methods.

methods.name: getQuoteCode
methods.description: Returns the quote code associated with this request.

methods.name: getAmountType
methods.description: Returns the amount type for this quote request.

methods.name: getFees
methods.description: Returns the fees associated with this quote request.

methods.name: normalizeAmounts
methods.description: Normalizes the amount fields to a specified currency.

methods.name: validateAndParse
methods.description: Validates and parses a JSON object into an InteropQuoteRequestData instance.
